library.name: Motion
library.description: Production-ready animation library for React, JavaScript, and Vue. Formerly Framer Motion.

items.name: Spring animations
items.description: Physics-based spring animations for natural motion. Configure stiffness, damping, and mass.

items.name: Layout animations
items.description: Animate layout changes automatically with the layout prop. Shared layout transitions across components.

items.name: Scroll-linked animations
items.description: Tie animation progress to scroll position with useScroll and useTransform for parallax and progress bars.

items.name: Exit animations
items.description: Animate components as they leave the tree using AnimatePresence and exit variants.

items.name: Gesture animations
items.description: Respond to hover, tap, pan, and drag with whileHover, whileTap, and drag props.

items.name: Reduced motion
items.description: Respect prefers-reduced-motion with useReducedMotion and MotionConfig. Prefer opacity/transform fallbacks.
items.accessibility_notes: Always gate decorative motion behind prefers-reduced-motion.

items.name: Stagger children
items.description: Orchestrate child animations with staggerChildren and delayChildren on parent variants.

items.name: SVG animations
items.description: Animate SVG pathLength, pathOffset, and attributes for line draws and morph-like effects.

items.name: AnimatePresence
items.description: Keep exiting components mounted until exit animations finish. Core pattern for modal and route transitions.

items.name: In-view animations
items.description: Trigger animations when elements enter the viewport with whileInView and useInView.

items.name: Hero reveal pattern
items.description: Staggered hero headline and CTA entrance using variants, spring, and optional scroll-linked opacity.
